breakdown.description: The pressure field is floating because no reference pressure is set. For an incompressible simulation to converge, pressure must be fixed at least at one point, typically the outlet, with a `fixedValue` condition. Setting all pressure boundaries to `zeroGradient` will lead to a solver failure.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use zeroGradient boundary conditions for the pressure field p on the inlet, top outlet (vortex finder), bottom dustOutlet, and all walls.' This repeats the original error exactly. No fixedValue condition is applied to the outlet (or any boundary), so the pressure field remains floating. The ground truth requires the outlet to have 'type fixedValue; value uniform 0;' to anchor the pressure, but this was not implemented.
